datasetRunId.title: Langfuse dataset-run id
datasetRunId.description: The run to judge; the Runner Actor returns this in its OUTPUT as datasetRunId. v1 judges by dataset-run id only; traceIds/filter inputs and full-log fetching are planned follow-ups.

judgeModel.title: Judge model (OpenRouter id)
judgeModel.description: Exact model id, never an alias; stamped into every score.

promptLabel.title: Judge prompt label
promptLabel.description: Langfuse prompt-management label; resolved to a concrete version once per batch.

force.title: Force re-judge
force.description: Write a new score set even when a matching (rubric, model, prompt, impl) set exists. Never mutates old scores.

langfuseBaseUrl.title: Langfuse base URL
langfuseBaseUrl.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_BASE_URL env var.

langfusePublicKey.title: Langfuse public key
langfusePublicKey.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY env var.

langfuseSecretKey.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuseSecretKey.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY env var.

artifactStore.title: Eval artifacts store
artifactStore.description: Named key-value store for full agent logs and tool-schema snapshots. Pick the store named eval-artifacts (id IoT4ipiOnFHyRsZQH); the picker grants this run access. Leave empty to use the default store by name.

writeRunScores.title: Write run-level scores
writeRunScores.description: pass_rate, found_rate, works_rate and friends on the dataset run. The runner sets this to false for filtered (team) runs so they do not move the OKR trend.

auditQueue.title: Audit queue
auditQueue.description: Langfuse annotation queue that receives every non-pass scenario plus a sample of passes for human review of the judge. Empty disables.

auditPassSample.title: Audit sample of passes
auditPassSample.description: Share of passing scenarios also sent to the audit queue (0 to 1).

datasetName.title: Suite (dataset) name
datasetName.description: Name of the Langfuse dataset the run belongs to; used to build the report. Resolved from the run when empty.

report.title: Build the report
report.description: After a full-scope run, regenerate the suite report (last 7 days) into the artifacts store as report-<suite>-latest.html and a dated copy.
